2 رشّدهُ , inf. n. تَرْشِيدٌ, said of a kádee, or judge, i. q. جَعَلَهُ رَشِيدًا [meaning He pronounced him to be one who took, or followed, a right way or course or direction: or to be one who held a right belief; to be orthodox]. (Msb.) ―
-b2- See also what next follows.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
